privacy.incognito_mode_desc: Stop the Grid from loading or refreshing, hide your read receipts, and stop reporting profile views — so you can browse without showing up as online or leaving a trace.
privacy.incognito_mode_note: While this is on: the Grid (including its background refresh) won't load, read receipts are never sent, and visiting someone's profile won't register as a view. Turning incognito mode off restores all of these immediately.
privacy.app_disguise_desc: Swap the app's home screen icon and name for a decoy, so it doesn't announce itself when someone else looks at your phone.
privacy.app_disguise_note: On Android, the launcher icon and name both update (some home screens only refresh once you go back to them). On iOS, only the icon can change — the name under it always stays "Free Grind", that's an OS limitation. Either way this doesn't affect notifications, which still show message previews unless you also adjust that under Notifications.
privacy.send_read_receipts_desc: Let others see when you've read their messages. Turn this off to read messages without them knowing until you reply.
privacy.per_chat_overrides_desc: Show an option in the chat menu to override the global setting for specific chats. Chats with read receipts hidden are highlighted in your Inbox.
privacy.read_receipts_hidden_badge: Read receipts hidden for this chat
privacy.read_receipts_shown_badge: Read receipts sent for this chat
privacy.record_profile_views_desc: Let people see that you've viewed their profile. Turn this off to browse profiles without leaving a trace.
privacy.read_receipts_grid_unread_note: With read receipts off, there's no way to tell the server you've read a message — so a chat can still show up as unread on the Grid even after you've read or deleted it.
privacy.show_sensitive_content_warning_desc: Show a warning screen before opening an album that could contain sensitive content.
privacy.blur_grid_profile_pictures_desc: Blur everyone's profile picture on the Grid, useful for browsing discreetly in public.

device_ban.title: Device Blocked
device_ban.description: You can't use your account on this device right now.
device_ban.card_text: Grindr answered with ACCOUNT_BANNED, which it also sends for requests it doesn't trust, for example because of the device fingerprint.
device_ban.fix_sign_out: Signing out creates a new device identity, which usually fixes it.

blackmail.title: Blackmail, extortion, and direct threats
blackmail.summary: Grindr strictly prohibits blackmail, extortion, and direct threats of harm. These behaviors endanger users and violate the guidelines, and may result in account bans.
blackmail.details: Blackmail, extortion, and direct threats of harm, including manipulation involving personal images or information, are strictly prohibited on Grindr. Such behavior endangers the safety of the community and goes against the guidelines.

bot_activity.title: Automated/bot activity
bot_activity.summary: Grindr cares about fostering genuine connections. Behaviors like sending mass messages, creating multiple profiles in bulk, or using tools to mimic real user actions are prohibited.
bot_activity.details: This account was flagged for violating Grindr’s policy on automated activity. This behavior compromises the security and authenticity of the community and goes against the guidelines. If you believe this action was taken in error, you can submit an appeal in the official Grindr app.

bullying.title: Targeted bullying and repeated abuse
bullying.summary: Treat others with kindness on Grindr. Bullying, harassment, and intimidation are prohibited, as they create a hostile environment. Repeated abusive behavior may result in further actions against the account.
bullying.details: Grindr is committed to creating a safe space for everyone. Repeated or targeted bullying violates the guidelines and disrupts the community experience. Please take this time to review the community guidelines and ensure your future interactions are respectful and supportive. Continued violations may lead to further action, including an account ban.

business_solicitation.title: Business solicitation
business_solicitation.summary: Using Grindr to promote businesses, paid services, or events is not allowed. Please keep interactions personal and free from business or solicitation purposes.
business_solicitation.details: Grindr is designed for personal connections, not for recruiting or soliciting users for profit-driven ventures like promoting businesses, paid services, or events. Such activities detract from the platform’s purpose and go against the guidelines.

casual_substances.title: Casual mentions of legal or non-illicit substances
casual_substances.summary: Non-illicit substances like CBD or marijuana (where legal) are okay to mention on Grindr. However, excessive promotion or focus on these substances may lead to the account being reported by the community, and even suspended.
casual_substances.details: Profiles centered around these substances or excessive promotion of them can detract from the community experience and may be reported by other users. Grindr prohibits drug-related content or imagery that could promote harmful practices.

consent_violation.title: Consent violations
consent_violation.summary: Consent isn’t only sexy, it’s mandatory – persistent sexual requests, coercive behavior, and all other behavior that disregards consent are prohibited on Grindr.
consent_violation.details: Grindr encourages users to provide transparent and explicit consent in all interactions. Persistent sexual requests, coercive behavior, or any actions that disregard another user’s boundaries are prohibited. Such behavior can create an unsafe and uncomfortable environment, violating the community guidelines and the principles of respect and safety.

drug_facilitation.title: Drug facilitation
drug_facilitation.summary: Helping others obtain illegal drugs isn’t allowed on Grindr. Continued violations may lead to an account ban.
drug_facilitation.details: Connecting others to illegal drugs — offering to share what you have, arranging a pickup, or putting someone in touch with a source — is not permitted, even when nothing is being sold. This goes against Grindr’s guidelines, as Grindr cares about your well-being and strives to maintain a safe, respectful community.
drug_facilitation.summary_banned: Helping others obtain illegal drugs isn’t allowed on Grindr. This account has been banned following repeated violations.

drug_promotion.title: Drug promotion or glorification
drug_promotion.summary: Repeated attempts to promote drugs are not allowed on Grindr.
drug_promotion.details: References to cannabis, tobacco, and alcohol are allowed in certain contexts, but Grindr does not allow profiles centered around or promoting drug content, including discussing or participating in the buying or selling of drugs (of any kind). This policy also extends to images and emojis that solicit drugs or promote drug use.

drug_seeking.title: Drug seeking
drug_seeking.summary: Seeking drugs on Grindr violates the guidelines.
drug_seeking.details: Seeking drugs, even occasionally, in your profile or chats is not permitted. This goes against Grindr’s guidelines, as Grindr cares about your well-being and strives to maintain a safe, respectful community.

occasional_drug_solicitation.title: Occasional drug solicitation
occasional_drug_solicitation.summary: Seeking drugs on Grindr violates the guidelines.
occasional_drug_solicitation.details: Seeking drugs, even occasionally, in your profile or chats is not permitted. This goes against Grindr’s guidelines, as Grindr cares about your well-being and strives to maintain a safe, respectful community.

frequent_drug_solicitation.title: Frequent drug solicitation
frequent_drug_solicitation.summary: Repeated attempts to seek drugs are not allowed on Grindr.
frequent_drug_solicitation.details: Grindr is a platform for genuine personal connections. Repeated attempts to seek drugs, whether directly or indirectly, disrupt the community experience and violate the guidelines. If such behavior continues, it may result in a longer account suspension or even a ban.

fraudulent_promotion.title: Scam and fraudulent promotions
fraudulent_promotion.summary: Grindr strictly prohibits scams or schemes that exploit or harm others.
fraudulent_promotion.details: This includes fraudulent schemes or deceptive behavior aimed at exploiting other users. Grindr takes the safety and security of its community seriously and does not tolerate such behavior.

general_advertising.title: General advertising and solicitation
general_advertising.summary: Grindr is for authentic personal connections, not for advertising goods, services, or external platforms. Promotional content is not allowed in profiles or messages.
general_advertising.details: Using profiles or messages to promote products, services, or share external links goes against the guidelines and disrupts the experience for others.

hate_speech.title: Hate speech and offensive content
hate_speech.summary: Hate speech and discriminatory language are prohibited on Grindr. Repeated abusive interactions create a hostile environment. Continued violations may lead to further action, including an account ban.
hate_speech.details: Grindr is committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful community. Hate speech and discriminatory language may create a hostile and unsafe environment for others. Please review the community guidelines and ensure your future interactions reflect respect and inclusivity.

impersonation.title: Impersonation and identity misuse
impersonation.summary: Grindr prohibits impersonating others or creating profiles that falsely represent someone’s identity. This behavior violates the guidelines and may result in account bans.
impersonation.details: This includes using another person’s name, photos, or personal details. Impersonation undermines trust, compromises safety, and violates the guidelines.

mild_insults.title: Mild insults and disrespect
mild_insults.summary: Some chats you’ve sent have been flagged as potentially disrespectful. Please be kind on Grindr, and ensure your interactions remain respectful in alignment with the community guidelines.
mild_insults.details: Grindr seeks to provide a space for respectful and authentic interactions. Comments that may seem unkind or disrespectful can negatively impact others and go against the community guidelines. Continued violations may result in account actions like suspension or ban.

mild_solicitation.title: Mild solicitation and casual offers
mild_solicitation.summary: Grindr is for genuine personal connections. Financial solicitations can blur boundaries and aren’t in line with the guidelines.
mild_solicitation.details: Grindr is for personal connections—not promoting paid content or financial arrangements.

non_consensual_intimate_imagery.title: Non-consensual intimate imagery
non_consensual_intimate_imagery.summary: Sharing intimate images or videos of another person without their consent isn’t allowed on Grindr. Continued violations may lead to an account ban.
non_consensual_intimate_imagery.details: Intimate images or videos of another person should only ever be shared with that person’s consent — and consent to take or receive an image isn’t consent to share it. This applies to edited and AI-generated images as well.
non_consensual_intimate_imagery.summary_banned: Sharing intimate images or videos of another person without their consent isn’t allowed on Grindr.

offline_incident.title: Serious offline incidents
offline_incident.summary: This account was banned following a report of harmful behavior. Safety and respect are non-negotiable on Grindr.
offline_incident.details: Grindr takes these actions to protect the safety of its community and maintain a respectful environment for all users.

paid_sexual_services.title: Paid sexual services
paid_sexual_services.summary: Offering or requesting sexual services for money or compensation is not allowed on Grindr.
paid_sexual_services.details: Grindr is for personal connections, not for commercial transactions. Offering or requesting sexual services for compensation, no matter the circumstances, violates the guidelines.

phishing.title: Phishing, fraud, and harmful links
phishing.summary: Grindr strictly prohibits sharing malicious links, phishing attempts, or harmful software.
phishing.details: Sharing malicious links, phishing attempts, or harmful software can deceive others or compromise their security. Accounts engaging in such activities may be banned to protect the platform and its users.

privacy_violation.title: Privacy violations and doxxing
privacy_violation.summary: Sharing someone’s personal information without their permission is strictly forbidden and compromises safety.
privacy_violation.details: Sharing another person’s private or personal information, such as contact details or identifying information, without their permission is a serious violation of the guidelines. This behavior puts others at risk and undermines the trust within the community.

profile_spam.title: Profile spam and advertising
profile_spam.summary: Grindr is for authentic connections, not for promoting goods, services, or external platforms. Promotional content isn’t allowed in profiles or chats.
profile_spam.details: Sharing ads, donation links, or event promotions in your profile or chats isn’t allowed and takes away from the authentic experience. Grindr is meant for genuine interactions—not selling services or hyping up events.

drug_sale.title: Drug sale and distribution
drug_sale.summary: Grindr strictly prohibits any activity involving the sale or distribution of drugs. Accounts engaging in such behavior will be banned.
drug_sale.details: Grindr does not allow profiles, chats, or content that facilitate the sale, distribution, or promotion of illegal substances. This policy is in place to support the well-being of users and to help maintain a safe, authentic environment for everyone, and violations of this nature are taken very seriously.

sextortion.title: Sextortion
sextortion.summary: Threatening to share someone’s intimate images or videos isn’t allowed on Grindr.
sextortion.details: Blackmail, extortion, and direct threats of harm, including manipulation involving personal images or information, are strictly prohibited. Such behavior endangers the safety of the community.

sexual_content_sale.title: Sale of sexually explicit content
sexual_content_sale.summary: Grindr is for making authentic connections, not for commercial transactions related to sexual content. Selling or promoting sexually explicit content (including your pictures or videos) is not allowed on Grindr.
sexual_content_sale.details: Selling or promoting sexually explicit material, including photos or videos, violates the guidelines and disrupts the community experience. Please ensure your profile and messages focus on building genuine connections within the community.

spam.title: Repeated or unwanted messaging
spam.summary: Sending repeated messages or excessive follow-ups is considered spammy behavior. Continued violations may lead to account suspension.
spam.details: Sending too many messages in a short time violates the guidelines. Always respect other users — read profiles for preferences, share your boundaries, and honor others’ limits.

transactional_service.title: Transactional services
transactional_service.summary: Grindr prohibits offering or requesting transactional services, such as paid companionship, even when non-sexual in nature.
transactional_service.details: These behaviors shift the platform away from its focus on personal, meaningful connections and violate the guidelines. Please ensure your interactions remain free from commercial intent.

underage_endangerment.title: Child protection and endangerment
underage_endangerment.summary: This account was banned following a report of harmful behavior. Safety and respect are non-negotiable on Grindr.

underage_impersonation.title: Underage impersonation
underage_impersonation.summary: Grindr is for adults only – you must be at least 18 years (or older, in some regions) before you can use Grindr. Underage activity, even in role-playing contexts, is prohibited.
underage_impersonation.details: Pretending to be a minor, whether for role-playing or any other reason, violates Grindr’s policies and may result in an account ban. Profiles impersonating other individuals, regardless of intent, undermine trust within the community and are not allowed.

underage.title: Underage access
underage.summary: Grindr is for adults only – you must be at least 18 years (or older, in some regions) to use Grindr.
underage.details: You must meet this age requirement to use the services, and Grindr takes this rule very seriously. Additionally, communicating with minors or sharing any images involving minors, no matter the context, is a serious violation of Grindr’s policies.

network_ban.title: Network Blocked
network_ban.description: You can't sign in from the network you're on right now.
network_ban.card_text: Grindr flags VPNs, proxies, and shared IP addresses this way. Your account itself isn't banned.
network_ban.fix_vpn: Turn off your VPN or proxy.
network_ban.fix_switch: Switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data, then sign in again.

underage_ban.description: You can't sign in until the ban is lifted. If you're 18 or older, appeal it to confirm your age.

info.daily_desc: One pill every day at roughly the same time. Protection builds up over your first doses and is maintained by staying consistent.
info.on_demand_desc: 2 pills 2-24h before sex, then 1 pill 24h after the first dose, then 1 pill 48h after the first dose. Log each step as you take it and the PrEP tab will track your coverage.
info.footer: This is a personal tracking tool. It doesn't replace medical advice — talk to a healthcare provider about what's right for you.

auto_translate.api_key_desc: Used for all chat translations. One key for the whole app, stored only on this device.
auto_translate.enabled_toast: Auto-translate turned on for this chat.
auto_translate.disabled_toast: Auto-translate turned off for this chat.
auto_translate.error_invalid_key: Translation failed. Check your API key. ({{message}})
auto_translate.already_in_language: This message is already in your language.
auto_translate.guide_project_desc: Sign in to the Google Cloud Console with your Google account and create a new project (or pick an existing one).
auto_translate.guide_billing_desc: The Translation API needs a billing account on the project. The first 500,000 characters per month are free, which is plenty for chat messages.
auto_translate.guide_api_desc: Open the Cloud Translation API in the API library and click Enable.
auto_translate.guide_key_desc: Go to APIs & Services → Credentials, click Create credentials → API key and copy it. Recommended: edit the key and restrict it to the Cloud Translation API.
auto_translate.key_saved_unverified: Saved, but the key couldn't be checked: {{message}}
auto_translate.key_status_invalid: This key doesn't work. Translate options in chats are hidden until it's fixed.
auto_translate.key_status_valid: Key is set up. Translate options are available in chats.
auto_translate.provider_google_desc: Fast, literal machine translation. Often misses slang and abbreviations.
auto_translate.provider_gemini_desc: AI translation that understands gay dating slang, abbreviations and context. Free tier with daily limits.
auto_translate.error_quota: Translation limit reached. Try again later. ({{message}})
auto_translate.guide_gemini_studio_desc: Sign in to Google AI Studio with your Google account and accept the terms.
auto_translate.guide_gemini_key_desc: Click Create API key, pick or create a project and copy the key. No billing is needed for the free tier.
auto_translate.guide_gemini_billing_desc: The free tier has daily limits, and Google may use free-tier content to improve its products. With billing enabled your messages aren't used for that, and a chat message costs only a fraction of a cent.
auto_translate.provider_openai_desc: AI translation by OpenAI that understands slang, abbreviations and context. Paid per use, a chat message costs a fraction of a cent.
auto_translate.provider_claude_desc: AI translation by Anthropic that understands slang, abbreviations and context. Paid per use, the most expensive option here.
auto_translate.guide_openai_platform_desc: Sign in to the OpenAI Platform with your OpenAI account. This is separate from a ChatGPT subscription.
auto_translate.guide_openai_billing_desc: The API is prepaid. Add a small amount under Billing; a few dollars last a long time for chat messages.
auto_translate.guide_openai_key_desc: Click Create new secret key and copy it right away; it's only shown once.
auto_translate.guide_claude_console_desc: Sign in to the Claude Console with your Anthropic account. This is separate from a Claude.ai subscription.
auto_translate.guide_claude_billing_desc: The API is prepaid. Buy credits under Billing before the key can be used.
auto_translate.guide_claude_key_desc: Click Create Key, give it a name and copy it right away; it's only shown once.
auto_translate.guide_paste_inline_desc: Paste the key and tap Save. It's checked right away.

unsupported_version.no_update: No newer version is out yet. Check again later.

harassment.title: Harassment
harassment.content: We encourage free expression, but not if it bullies or intimidates others. Please be kind on Grindr.
harassment.reason: You are seeing this warning because you were flagged for harassment in a recent interaction. If our moderation team receives reports about other incidents, your account may be banned for violating our Community Guidelines.
harassment.details: We ask that you treat others with kindness on Grindr. Bullying, harassment, and intimidation are prohibited, as they create a hostile environment. Repeated abusive behavior may result in further actions against your account.

commercial.title: Commercial activity
commercial.content: Grindr is for personal use only. We can’t allow you to ask for money, advertise, or use Grindr to buy or sell anything. If this happens again, you may be banned.
commercial.reason: You are seeing this warning because you were flagged for commercial activity in a recent interaction. If our moderation team receives reports about other incidents, your account may be banned for violating our Community Guidelines.
commercial.details: Grindr is designed for personal connections, not for recruiting or soliciting users for profit-driven ventures like promoting businesses, paid services, or events. Such activities detract from the platform’s purpose and go against our guidelines. Please ensure your interactions remain personal and non-commercial.

mild_insults.title: Mild insults and disrespect
mild_insults.content: Some chats you’ve sent have been flagged as potentially disrespectful. While we encourage you to be yourself and express yourself freely on Grindr, it’s important to do so without negatively impacting others. Please be kind on Grindr, and ensure your interactions remain respectful in alignment with our community guidelines.
mild_insults.reason: You are seeing this warning because you were flagged for mild insults and disrespect in a recent interaction. If our moderation team receives reports about other incidents, your account may be banned for violating our Community Guidelines.
mild_insults.details: Grindr seeks to provide a space for respectful and authentic interactions. Comments that may seem unkind or disrespectful can negatively impact others and go against our community guidelines. authentic.title: Be authentic
authentic.text:
Be yourself on the app, not someone else. Any profiles impersonating other people, including celebrities, will be banned. Content that you post on Grindr should be of you or by you, and you should represent yourself truthfully. You choose what to disclose about yourself, but the information that you do share should be true. Any impersonation/catfishing is prohibited and may result in a ban.

We don't allow:
• Photos of celebrities or public figures of any kind (actors, musicians, politicians, etc.)
• Photos of celebrity impersonators where it could be unclear if the person is an impersonator or the actual celebrity
• Pictures that are copyrighted, have watermarks, or that we believe to not be of you or taken by you
• Junk photos (like solid black boxes)

If your profile is reported as being fake, we may ask you to verify your identity to keep your profile active.

harassment.title: Harassment
harassment.text:
We want you to be yourself and express yourself freely here, but not at the expense of someone else. We strongly suggest you talk about what you are into, not what you aren't, on your profile. And the old adage "if you can't say something nice, don't say anything at all" pertains here just like at your grandmother's.

We also expect you to leave someone alone when they indicate they want to be left alone. This is a foundational rule. Misusing our reporting system to get back at someone who's blocked you, or creating new accounts to continue patterns of unwanted contact will result in a permanent ban.

hate.title: Hate, violence, and offensive content
hate.text:
It should go without saying, but we don't allow hate speech or violence of any kind. If we learn that you have abused or seriously threatened another user, you will be banned forever. We may also remove content that we find too graphic, offensive, or insensitive and hurtful, even if there was no ill intent.

We take reports of violence, threats and assault very seriously. This includes incidents that occur both on and off our platform.

We may consider content hate speech (and take more severe actions against a profile) if it promotes or condones racism, bigotry, violence, hate, dehumanization, or harm against individuals or groups based on race, ethnicity, disability, age, nationality, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, religion, or appearance.

Content we would consider graphic, violent or offensive includes but is not limited to:
• Photos of weapons and firearms (real or toy), including paintball guns
• Photos with blood or gore, including especially realistic costumes
• Violent images, including cartoons or illustrations
• Gang signs or offensive hand gestures (e.g. middle finger)
• Kink or fetish content that is violent or promotes harm
• Threats against any person or group, including political figures
• Photos or descriptions of self-harm or suicide
• Photos of dead animals, including hunting photos
• Jokes or memes that can be found to be hurtful and insensitive

minors.title: Minors
minors.text:
Grindr is for adults ONLY. You must be at least 18 to use the app (or older in certain jurisdictions). We take this age limit very, very seriously, and any violation or suspected violation will result in a ban, at a minimum, and could lead us to involve the appropriate authorities.

We also do not allow any photos of anyone under 18, in any context. This includes photos where a minor's face is blurred out or is in the background. Our total ban on minor activity extends to communication: if a user communicates with another user that they believe to be under 18, that is also a violation of our age policy.

obey_the_law.text:
If something is illegal offline, well guess what: it's also illegal on Grindr! Yes, this includes drugs. Illegal content and depictions of illegal activity will be taken down and, when appropriate, reported to the appropriate authorities.

We allow casual mentions of marijuana, over the counter medication, and prescribed medications. However, evidence of misuse or encouraging others to use irresponsibly, as well as any discussion of buying/selling, will result in a ban. We do not allow any mention of non-prescription drugs, other than marijuana, unless in the context of addiction recovery. Also, we do not allow profiles mainly focused on drug content.

private_information.title: Private information
private_information.text:
Grindr will never ask you for personal details like your password or your credit card information. Other users don't need to know this stuff either. In the interest of safety, we will remove any sensitive personal information displayed publicly, such as phone numbers and addresses, and we may suspend or ban the profile.

Unwelcome solicitation of another user's personal information, prompting users to visit outside links, or any kind of spamming or scamming will get you banned.

We do not allow the posting of private information anywhere on the profile, such as photos or profile text, or direct links to it, for example through a QR code or link. Private information includes:
• Unlisted contact information, such as phone numbers, email addresses, home/work address
• Social security numbers, passports, passwords, financial information
